context.problem_statement: Perform differential gene expression analysis between a Disease group and a Healthy control group. For each gene (columns G1-G10), compute: (1) log2 fold change (log2(mean_disease / mean_healthy)), (2) two-sample t-test p-value, (3) Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted p-value (FDR). Identify significantly differentially expressed genes using thresholds: |log2FC| > 1.0 AND FDR < 0.05. Report the number of upregulated and downregulated genes.
context.expert_knowledge: Log2 fold change > 1 means upregulated in disease (2x expression increase), < -1 means downregulated. Use scipy.stats.ttest_ind for t-tests. Apply Benjamini-Hochberg correction via statsmodels.stats.multitest.multipletests with method='fdr_bh'. Volcano plots visualize significance vs magnitude of change.
